description: This file defines functions related to 'template' rules in a build system, including documentation, constants, and the implementation of RunTemplate() which registers templates within a scope.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Represents a build template that can be defined and invoked within the build system scope.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a scope in which build rules, variables, and templates are defined.

methods.name: RunTemplate
methods.description: Defines and registers a new template in the given scope based on the provided arguments and block.
